definitions.explanation: Something said to explain or justify an action; commonly used in apologetic expressions.

examples.japanese: {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません。
{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ないが、{今日|きょう}は{無理|むり}だ。
examples.english: I'm sorry, but today is impossible.
examples.notes: 申し訳ない = sorry (slightly less formal)

examples.japanese: {遅|おく}れて{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません。
examples.english: I'm very sorry for being late.
examples.notes: 申し訳ございません = most polite form

notes:
USAGE: {申|もう}し{訳|わけ} is primarily used in apology expressions and is very polite. It literally means "excuse" or "explanation."

POLITENESS LEVELS:
・{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません (most polite/formal)
・{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません (very polite)
・{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ない (casual but still apologetic)

CONTRAST:
・{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません - very polite apology
・すみません - standard polite apology
・ごめんなさい - casual apology
・ごめん - very casual apology
